text: Lost Frames — a podcast about films that almost weren't
A weekly limited series. Each episode unpacks a single film whose final cut diverged sharply from its original vision — the lost frames left on the cutting-room floor.
EP1 — In the Mood for Love
Wong Kar-wai (2000). 98 minutes. The discarded longer cut, the original Maggie Cheung wardrobe, and the score that was almost half Nat King Cole and half new commission.
